items.text: I would like to congratulate President Xi, and the Great Country of China, on their massive Birthright Citizenship WIN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Cook Lawsuit, having to do with her suitability in sitting on the Board of the Federal Reserve, was sent back by the Supreme Court on a strictly procedural basis, we will take appropriate action immediately to make sure that someone who has committed wrongdoing will not be making vital decisions concerning the Welfare of the United States of America! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称最高法院程序性驳回Cook案，将'立即采取行动'确保有问题的人不在Fed做决策，加大美联储独立性/人事动荡风险，利好金融板块、短线扰动利率路径。

items.author: Trump
items.text: WTI CRUDE - $69, and heading down. This is less than it was prior to the start of the Denuclearization of Iran! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称WTI跌至69美元、低于伊朗'去核'之前水平，暗示油价受其外交政策压制，短线偏空能源股。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Gasoline Retailers must get their Prices down, IMMEDIATELY! They’re too high considering that Oil is now at $68 a Barrel, and heading south. The Retailers must quickly react to this statement, and do what they know is right — DROP YOUR PRICE FOR OUR GREAT AMERICAN PEOPLE! There will be no gauging, which is totally illegal. If Retailers don’t do this, big problems lie ahead! Start targeting around the $2.50 a Gallon number, and California should stop charging such heavy Taxes on their Gasoline. Soon the Tax will be higher than the Product itself, and the United States will not stand for it, nor
items.summary_cn: 特朗普公开施压加油站降价，称WTI已跌至68美元、加州汽油税过高，威胁'有大麻烦'，短线压制石油/能源板块情绪。

items.author: Trump
items.text: IRAN HAS REQUESTED A MEETING. IT WILL TAKE PLACE TOMORROW IN DOHA! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣布伊朗请求明天在多哈会面，伊朗局势/核谈判进展将直接影响油价与避险资产。

items.author: Trump
items.text: GAS PRICES COMING DOWN, FAST! REPORT ANY ABUSES AT RETAIL LEVEL!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣称'油价快速下跌'并呼吁举报加油站价格垄断，消费端利好但压制能源股。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's X Money — New Details On Bank Killer Super App
items.summary_cn: 报道X Money超级应用新细节，拟颠覆银行业，潜在冲击支付/金融科技板块。

items.author: Trump
items.text: BIG WIN just moments ago at the Supreme Court, in the Slaughter Case, confirming Presidential Power in our Country to remove Executive Branch Officers and Agency Appointees, or Representatives, under Article II. This Decision was long sought by United States Presidents, dating all the way back to the 1930s. It is such an Honor to be the sitting President who won this Historic and Unprecedented Ruling, one of the most important ever given with respect to Presidential Powers. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 最高法院Slaughter案裁决扩大总统罢免行政/独立机构官员权力，强化特朗普对Fed等机构的掌控力，间接影响监管板块。
